groundTruth.rootCause: Product image requests through frontend-proxy are delayed by 5sec; image-provider itself stays fast.
acceptableAlternatives: image requests are delayed before they reach image-provider

hypothesis: The most likely cause is a delay added inside frontend-proxy (Envoy) itself, not in any downstream service. Starting at 10:25 its p95 latency jumped from about 35 ms to 3.2–4.1 s, while frontend, flagd and image-provider latency stayed flat. In this demo that pattern matches the imageSlowLoad flag, which makes Envoy fault-inject a delay on image requests before they reach image-provider. I could not confirm the flag is on: the log search did not filter by path and there were no slow traces to fetch. Treat the flag as the leading suspect.
